info.name: Execute a SQL query against your analytics data (experimental)

items.docs:
⚠️ **Experimental** — this endpoint may change or be removed without notice and is not subject to v2 backwards-compatibility guarantees. Do not build production-critical integrations against it yet.

Runs a single ClickHouse SELECT (or WITH … SELECT) against your organization's analytics views. Before writing a query, call `getAnalyticsSchema` (GET /schema) for the available views and columns, and `getSignalsMetadata` (GET /signals/metadata) for the JSON paths inside `fact_signal.data`. info.name: List queryable analytics views, columns, and types (experimental)

items.docs:
⚠️ **Experimental** — this endpoint may change or be removed without notice and is not subject to v2 backwards-compatibility guarantees. Do not build production-critical integrations against it yet.

Returns the analytics views available to POST /query, with column names, ClickHouse types, and descriptions. Dimensions (`dim_*`) describe entities; facts (`fact_*`) are event/transaction tables that join to dimensions via the `*_id` columns described in each comment.

info.name: Discover metadata keys present in your signals (experimental)

params.name: signalName
params.description: Restrict discovery to a single signal name.

params.name: fromDate
params.description: Start of the discovery window. Defaults to 30 days ago.

params.name: toDate
params.description: End of the discovery window. Defaults to now.

items.docs:
⚠️ **Experimental** — this endpoint may change or be removed without notice and is not subject to v2 backwards-compatibility guarantees. Do not build production-critical integrations against it yet.

Lists the JSON paths (and their observed types) present in the `data` payload of your signals within a time window (default: last 30 days), grouped by signal name. Use the returned paths in queries against `fact_signal`, e.g. `WHERE data.<path>::String = '...'`.
